description: Japanese THE BEST OF XY card backfill. Assisted by Codex.
method: Regular card text, illustrator, printed rarity, and gameplay fields are transcribed from official Pokémon Card Game detail pages. Every page’s printed card number is read directly and checked for a gap-free sequence before import; page URLs and SHA-256 hashes are listed per card.
The full Japanese numbered sequence is reconciled against an independent set checklist. Parallel print records are grouped only when the official pages carry the same printed number and name.

Secret-tail card faces are checked against the numbered Japanese scans and individual numbered checklist entries. Where the official detail page covers a same-mechanics print, gameplay fields come from that official record; secret-only flavor text is omitted.

Printed rarity labels map to the repository taxonomy. Rare foil variants follow the Japanese printing; on sets with existing zh-tw entries, variant overrides are limited to Japanese so existing-language printing behavior is retained.
No third-party artwork URLs or marketplace identifiers are inferred. The source references document catalog data and printed scans; no images are added to the repository.
Assisted by Codex; card text and identities remain sourced from the cited card records and numbered prints.
